name: Tracing Pencil
text: Before bidding, this sigil becomes a copy of a random sigil an opponent owns for the round.
archetypes: Contract Attacker, Exact Contractor, Swap Meet
decision: None at the table; the copy shows what an opponent owns, which helps reading their plan.
opponent: Each shows one sigil; they lose nothing else, and the copy is visible when it triggers.
aiNote: Prefer an always-on contract payoff, then a card-bound sigil that suits this card; never copy a shop or selling sigil, which does nothing during a round.
rationale: Opponents' collections are a sample of good purchases, so a random one lands near an average common payoff (about +10) with an occasional rare, and the copy reveals part of an opponent's plan; unlike Surprise Takeaway (GY-C08) it copies real opponent sigils.
deviation: Revision 1: copies one random opponent sigil instead of choosing between two revealed ones.
